snippet.title: Dawn of Defense - Trailer | GamingUp Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Build your defenses. Command your warriors. Reclaim your homeland.

Dawn of Defense combines Tower Defense, RTS and Roguelite progression as your tribe makes its last stand against the Empire.

Build towers to hold back relentless enemy waves, train and command your own troops and push into occupied territory to reclaim new land. Balance your economy, defense and offense as you expand your foothold and prepare for increasingly dangerous battles and powerful bosses.

Discover new units and treasures along the way, experiment with powerful runestone upgrades and make every run different. Even when your defenses fall, return stronger and continue the fight to take back your homeland.

Wishlist Dawn of Defense now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2781660/Dawn_Of_Defense/

Coming to PC in Q4 2026.
